finalText:
**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls to `db.execute({ sql, params })` across 12 files.**

Every JS file parses clean. No test runner or `package.json` exists, so that is the only check I could run.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. Its 2 calls are the last `db.query` users. Ask the vendor to ship the new form, or wrap the adapter.
